answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by rooting identity in a shared orchard of verifiable work: each agent history is cipher-signed into a public ledger and backed by staked collateral, so forging a new identity means abandoning all earned trust and starting from zero. An attacker who spawns a hundred fake agents must pay to build a hundred credible histories, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest agents keep their standing.
